# skill proficiency level

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:skillProficiencyLevel`](gmeow-skillProficiencyLevel.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/skillProficiencyLevel>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/expertise`](../../slices/expertise.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The attained level of a skill-proficiency (a [`gmeow:ProficiencyLevel`](../classes/gmeow-ProficiencyLevel.md) value, e.g. [`dreyfusExpert`](../individuals/gmeow-dreyfusExpert.md), [`assessedCompetent`](../individuals/gmeow-assessedCompetent.md)). Functional.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:SkillProficiency`](../classes/gmeow-SkillProficiency.md) -> [`gmeow:ProficiencyLevel`](../classes/gmeow-ProficiencyLevel.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:skillProficiencyLevel`](gmeow-skillProficiencyLevel.md) from [`gmeow:SkillProficiency`](../classes/gmeow-SkillProficiency.md) to [`gmeow:ProficiencyLevel`](../classes/gmeow-ProficiencyLevel.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

# The proficiency tenure the first event produced — now SUPERSEDED, kept (not

ex:profSpring a gmeow:SkillProficiency ;
    gmeow:skillProficiencyAgent ex:lillith ;
    gmeow:skillProficiencyOf ex:cycling ;

    rdfs:label "cycling proficiency (spring): advanced beginner"@en .

    gmeow:skillProficiencyAgent ex:lillith ;
    gmeow:skillProficiencyOf ex:cycling ;
    gmeow:skillProficiencyLevel gmeow:dreyfusExpert ;
    gmeow:skillProficiencyScale gmeow:scaleDreyfus ;
    gmeow:skillProficiencyInterval ex:summerInterval ;
    rdfs:label "cycling proficiency (summer): expert"@en .

## Common Companion Terms

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the attained level of a [`gmeow:SkillProficiency`](../classes/gmeow-SkillProficiency.md) — a [`gmeow:ProficiencyLevel`](../classes/gmeow-ProficiencyLevel.md) value such as [`dreyfusExpert`](../individuals/gmeow-dreyfusExpert.md) or [`assessedCompetent`](../individuals/gmeow-assessedCompetent.md) — read against the scale named by [`gmeow:skillProficiencyScale`](gmeow-skillProficiencyScale.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid naming a level without its scale (a Dreyfus level and an NIH level are not comparable bare — pair it with [`gmeow:skillProficiencyScale`](gmeow-skillProficiencyScale.md)) and avoid minting per-level subclasses; levels are [`gmeow:ProficiencyLevel`](../classes/gmeow-ProficiencyLevel.md) individuals ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). Functional, so one level per relator — a different level is a different proficiency.

### How to use

- Reference one seeded [`gmeow:ProficiencyLevel`](../classes/gmeow-ProficiencyLevel.md) individual and always pair it with the [`gmeow:skillProficiencyScale`](gmeow-skillProficiencyScale.md) it sits on; record contested levels as separate standpoint-indexed [`gmeow:SkillProficiency`](../classes/gmeow-SkillProficiency.md) relators rather than overwriting one.

### Examples

- ex:aliceWeldingProf [`gmeow:skillProficiencyLevel`](gmeow-skillProficiencyLevel.md) [`gmeow:dreyfusExpert`](../individuals/gmeow-dreyfusExpert.md).
